plainText:
Jessie's Woobat (Japanese: ムサシのコロモリ Musashi's Koromori) is the first Pokémon that Jessie in the Unova region, and her eighth overall.

==History==
=== ===
====Unova====
 
In Enter Iris and Axew!, while in a cave planning their move, the Team Rocket trio saw a group of . Jessie caught one off-screen, as was revealed when Jessie called him out to battle 's newly acquired . He was able to defeat the with a single Gust as she was already weakened during her battle with . He was then defeated by 's after he had worn and out.

In Scare at the Litwick Mansion!, Woobat teamed up with James's Yamask, Ash's Oshawott, Ash's Pikachu, and Cilan's Dwebble to defeat the and their leader.

In A Restoration Confrontation! Part 1, Woobat was used to capture a that Dr. Zager had just resurrected, however it escaped after blowing a hole in the helicopter with . In the next episode, Woobat battled to capture the Prototurtle Pokémon alongside Yamask, until Tirtouga evolved into and fled the scene. Woobat later battled and Cilan's Pansage as they tied to rescue the captured Carracosta before the time gate at Twist Mountain.
 
Sometime before An Epic Defense Force!, Team Rocket began tracking for their latest plan, Operation Tempest. Woobat later teamed up with Yamask to expose the Melody Pokémon. tried to catch it in an electric net but Meloetta escaped through its invisibility. In Meloetta and the Undersea Temple!, Woobat and Yamask confronted Ash and his friends so that Team Rocket could steal Meloetta. He battled against Iris's Axew and Cilan's Pansage while pursued Ash and Meloetta. Then in the next episode, Woobat and Yamask used their combined attacks to launch Ash off the top of the ancient temple to prevent him from interfering with Operation Tempest. After the operation failed, Woobat joined Jessie in retreating to Kanto.

When Jessie returned to Unova in New Places...Familiar Faces!, she brought Woobat with her, as revealed in The Light of Floccesy Ranch!, where he was blasted off by an Team Rocket attempted to steal.

In Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!, Woobat was used to battle Aldith's alongside as Jessie, James, and Meowth tried to steal Colress's Pokémon manipulation machine. Eventually Liepard's veered and hit Colress's machine, releasing Iris's Dragonite and Rhoder's which were under his control.

In What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!, Woobat helped fight off Team Plasma's controlled Pokémon.

====Decolore Islands====
In Team Rocket's Shocking Recruit!, Woobat battled Ash and for the final time in . Team Rocket had managed to trap Iris's Axew and , and Ash's Snivy stepped up to save them. Woobat tried to stop her with Air Slash, but was pushed back by multiple s and a . The Pokémon were then freed by a variety of attacks and Team Rocket was blasted off.

Woobat was given away to for Team Rocket in The Dream Continues!.

=== ===
In Rocket Revengers!, Woobat, alongside the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon at , were sent to Jessie and James so they could be added back to their team. Realizing the potential of such a large group, the team hatched a scheme to isolate Ash's Pikachu and capture him. Woobat was one of the many Pokémon that waited at the end of the trap, where he ambushed an isolated Pikachu. When the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon returned, Woobat joined them to launch a combined attack at the Mouse Pokémon. However, it was dodged, and ended up sending it back with . A wild that had been following Ash then intervened and sent the evil group blasting off.

==Personality and characteristics==
 
 
Woobat has shown to have a personality like Jessie as shown in Crisis at Chargestone Cave!, where Woobat was shown to like picking on Pokémon weaker and smaller than himself, shown when he was happy to chase and attack a small , but in A Fishy Connoisseur in a Fishy Competition!, Woobat was weak and frightened when he was about to be hit by Pansage's and when seeing Cilan's Dwebble evolve.

Woobat is the only Pokémon owned by to never emerge from his on his own.
Woobat is the only Unova Pokémon owned by Team Rocket to have never had his English voice actor replaced.
